name: data-grid-find-replace
title: Data Grid Find and Replace
author: gridcn
description: Find-and-replace add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridFindReplace returns a plugin that adds a panel (Ctrl+H) sharing the quick search, with match case and whole cell options. Replace and Replace all write through each column's text codec and validation as one undoable change; planReplace is the pure planner behind them. Strings live under labels.findReplace.
